author: Ari Koslow
title: Dominic Canzone goes yard Thursday
desc: Dominic Canzone went 2-for-5 with a home run in the Mariners 8-4 loss against the Marlins on Thursday.
impact: Canzone hit a two-run blast in the eighth inning with Seattle trailing 8-2. He continues to play every day after working himself out of a platoon.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bryce Miller struggles in loss Thursday
desc: Bryce Miller allowed six runs (four earned) on nine hits over five innings with three strikeouts and four walks in a loss on Thursday against the Marlins.
impact: Miller had been so dominant since making his season debut and it all came crashing down against a Marlins team on fire. He struggled with his command as he walked four and struggled to put away many hitters. He'll still take a dominant 2.18 ERA into the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Mangum collects four hits Thursday
desc: Jake Mangum went 4-for-5 with a home run and three RBI in the Pirates 10-5 loss against the Braves on Thursday.
impact: Mangum drove in three of the five runs for Pittsburgh, including a two-run long ball. He is hitting .311 on the season with 18 steals.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Esmerlyn Valdez goes yard Thursday
desc: Esmerlyn Valdez went 1-for-4 with a home run in the Pirates 10-5 loss against the Braves on Thursday.
impact: Valdez went back-to-back with Bryan Reynolds to put the Pirates on the board. He is up to seven long balls on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mitch Keller pitches three innings Thursday
desc: Mitch Keller allowed three runs on four hits over three innings with three strikeouts and two walks in a loss on Thursday against the Braves.
impact: Keller continued his recent struggles into the All-Star break. He'll look to regain his form as an innings eater after the break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Manny Machado hits home run Thursday
desc: Manny Machado went 2-for-3 with a home run in the Padres 3-1 loss against the Diamondbacks on Thursday.
impact: Machado made his return to the lineup from a one-game absence. He is up to 19 long balls on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Griffin Canning allows two runs Thursday
desc: Griffin Canning allowed two runs on seven hits over 4 2/3 innings with five strikeouts in a loss on Thursday against the Diamondbacks.
impact: Canning threw three scoreless frames before allowing a run in the fourth and fifth innings. He is off the fantasy radar heading into the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nolan Arenado hits home run Thursday
desc: Nolan Arenado went 1-for-4 with a home run in the Diamondbacks 4-1 win over the Padres on Thursday.
impact: Arenado extended the Diamondbacks lead to 3-1 with a solo shot in the sixth inning. It was his second home run early in July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Paul Sewald logs save Thursday
desc: Paul Sewald threw a clean inning for the save on Thursday against the Padres.
impact: Sewald needed just 10 pitches with two strikeouts to earn his 21st save on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Merrill Kelly tosses seven innings in win Thursday
desc: Merrill Kelly allowed one run on three hits over seven innings with six strikeouts and three walks in a win on Thursday against the Padres.
impact: The lone damage against Kelly was a solo shot hit by Manny Machado in the second inning. He allowed just two other hits in seven strong innings of work. He'll take some momentum into the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Waldschmidt recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Diamondbacks recalled Ryan Waldschmidt from Triple-A Reno.
impact: Waldschmidt will add depth in the outfield with Pavin Smith designated for assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Pavin Smith designated for assignment
desc: The Diamondbacks designated Pavin Smith for assignment.
impact: Smith is hitting just .141 on the season. He will head to waivers as a result.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zack Gelof (knee) to undergo MRI Friday
desc: Zack Gelof is scheduled to undergo an MRI on Friday.
impact: Gelof has a deep laceration under his right kneecap following his early exit on Thursday. There should be an update on his status on Friday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jacob Lopez to open game for Athletics Friday
desc: Jacob Lopez will open Friday's game for the Athletics against the White Sox.
impact: Lopez was recalled from Triple-A earlier this week. It is unclear how far he'll go on the mound.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Ben Rice goes yard twice, drives in five in win over Rays
desc: Ben Rice went 2-for-4 in Thursday's 12-4 win over the Rays with two home runs, five RBI, three runs scored, and one walk.
impact: Rice continues an explosive stretch at the plate, homering in five of his last nine contests. The first baseman remains one of the more dynamic bats in a Yankees lineup still without Aaron Judge and Giancarlo Stanton for manager Aaron Boone, carrying a .956 OPS with 28 home runs, 65 RBI, 63 runs scored, and two stolen bases across 88 games.
